summary: mymatasan ships a built-in, four-language (English/Malay/Chinese/Arabic) user manual compiled into the binary: markdown articles served with no network access, reachable from the sign-in screen, the first-run wizard, and a new Help nav item (every role) plus a contextual '?' help button in the workspace header and on the pre-session screens. Backed by a new shared, app-agnostic library (domain/shared/manual, generalizing myiotsan's single-language kb) that handles language index/bundle/fallback, and a new shared frontend module (@shared/Manual) providing the reader, full-text search, the contextual slide-over drawer, and whole-manual printing (renders every article with a table of contents via the browser print dialog). Six articles ship at launch (welcome, first sign-in, setup wizard, restore from backup, workspace tour, using this manual), each present in all four languages -- enforced by a conformance test (domain/shared/manual/manualcheck) that checks language parity, cross-link resolution, and heading-anchor consistency. Served publicly (no auth) under GET /api/manual, /api/manual/bundle, /api/manual/{slug}, /api/manual/assets/{name} -- deliberately mounted on the public router and kept off the RBAC permission matrix, since it is shipped read-only reference content with no per-user data. This is phase 1 of a suite-wide manual, starting with mymatasan; other apps adopt the same shared library in later phases.
compatibility: Backward compatible, additive only. New public, unauthenticated GET routes under /api/manual (read-only, no runtime state); no existing route, config key, or permission changes. Existing installs get the Help nav item and help links automatically on upgrade with no migration or config step. No new external dependencies -- the markdown renderer and manual assets are embedded in the binary and ship with the app.
